scope.sourcePolicy: Primary papers, official proceedings pages, official project pages, and official code repositories only.

queryFamilies: latency, pose, calibration, clock drift, and age-of-information alignment
adaptive and fully untrusted cooperative-perception attacks
anytime-valid risk control under adaptive selection
simulation, replay, vehicle-in-the-loop, and real-world evidence transfer
retrievalLimitations: No cooperative-perception paper was found that identifies message-level causal effects from logged adaptive communication without an explicit randomized logging policy.
Several 2026 papers promise code or data but do not yet expose a verified official release; future-release statements were not treated as executable evidence.
Vehicle-in-the-loop facilities are described in primary papers, but a public paired benchmark spanning all evidence levels was not found.

strongestCollisions: UECP already learns physically supervised uncertainty for weighting and suppressing unreliable contributions.
RCP-Bench already defines positive and negative collaboration coefficients under agent-specific corruptions.
CATNet and mmCooper already combine alignment, denoising, selection, and robust multi-stage fusion.
Fusion or Confusion directly demonstrates that additional V2X evidence can create ghost objects and safety-relevant false positives.
unidentifiedVariables: A fused log never contains the simultaneous no-message outcome for the same scene and downstream policy state.
Message admission is confounded by occlusion, ego confidence, collaborator visibility, network quality, and scene difficulty.
Per-frame perception harm does not identify horizon-level planning harm because the planner may ignore, compensate for, or amplify the error.
dataLeakageRisks: Training the gate with post-fusion ground-truth errors or future trajectory outcomes unavailable at decision time.
Splitting random frames instead of complete routes, actors, maps, corruption seeds, and communication traces.
Calibrating rejection thresholds on the same perturbation families used for the final robustness claim.
evaluationShortcuts: Rejecting nearly every message and reporting selective accuracy without coverage and fallback utility.
Reporting AP improvement while omitting closed-loop collisions, minimum TTC, progress, comfort, and actual serialized bytes.
Using oracle corruption severity, attacker identity, or ground-truth pose as a gate input.
implementationRisks: Paired counterfactual rollouts are expensive and reactive traffic makes replay non-equivalent to intervention.
Adaptive admission invalidates ordinary held-out calibration unless the logging and stopping process is modeled.
A detector-specific gate may not transfer across backbones, planners, or communication policies.
mechanismAudits.redTeamDisposition: Do not review as a standalone confidence gate. Merge it with an explicit randomized logging design and a horizon-level causal estimand.

strongestCollisions: TraF-Align reconstructs current-time features through learned object trajectory fields.
IPDA performs joint temporal and spatial co-sensing calibration.
CATNet jointly addresses temporal latency and multi-source noise.
Network synchronization plus Age of Information explicitly models clock state, delay, alignment uncertainty, and fusion weights.
unidentifiedVariables: Clock offset, clock drift, network delay, object motion, pose bias, and extrinsic bias can induce nearly identical residual motion.
Dynamic-object residuals cannot identify sensor extrinsics without static anchors or controlled excitation.
A flexible neural aligner can absorb the error without recovering a physically meaningful posterior.
dataLeakageRisks: Using future frames to estimate the current posterior in an online claim.
Using simulator ground-truth timestamps, poses, or object correspondences at inference.
Generating train and test perturbations from the same route and random process.
evaluationShortcuts: Injecting independent Gaussian delay and pose noise while claiming robustness to correlated drift.
Reporting AP only, without posterior NLL, coverage, calibration, state-recovery error, or recovery time.
Comparing a posterior model only against point estimators with weaker backbones or different temporal context.
implementationRisks: Real datasets often lack ground truth for every latent error state.
Posterior collapse and overconfident multi-modal alignment can make sampling worse than a point estimate.
CUDA and sequence-memory costs grow quickly when posterior samples are propagated through fusion.
mechanismAudits.redTeamDisposition: Potentially reviewable only with designed interventions that separate latent factors and with online, no-future-information evaluation.

strongestCollisions: Select2Drive uses area-of-importance communication to improve decision efficacy under resource limits.
Defer to Plan directly optimizes planning through adaptive multi-agent fusion.
WhisperNet performs receiver-centric global request planning under a communication budget.
MDrive shows that perception sharing does not consistently improve planning and supplies a closed-loop benchmark.
unidentifiedVariables: High-risk scenes cause both higher communication demand and worse outcomes, confounding message value.
The value of a message depends on the receiving planner, current policy state, other messages, and future traffic reactions.
Per-message marginal value is not additive when messages overlap or interact.
dataLeakageRisks: Using future collisions, route completion, or privileged planner rollouts as an online selector input.
Learning and evaluating value with the same planner, scenario generator, and communication policy.
Counting tensor elements or masks instead of serialized payload plus protocol overhead.
evaluationShortcuts: Open-loop L2 trajectory error in place of reactive closed-loop safety.
A single scalar driving score that hides collision, progress, comfort, and violation trade-offs.
Perception AP per byte presented as planning safety value per byte.
implementationRisks: Reliable message-level credit assignment needs expensive paired or randomized rollouts.
Planner-specific value models can reverse rankings under a different planner.
A learned selector may exploit simulator artifacts or communication timing.
mechanismAudits.redTeamDisposition: Reject as a standalone candidate in its current form. Treat planning value as an outcome inside a causal message-admission study, not as an independently identified quantity.

strongestCollisions: Recent driving work uses synthetic counterfactual interventions to learn object relevance.
MDrive and EI-Drive provide closed-loop environments in which communication interventions can be executed.
No direct 2024-2026 collision was found for logged randomized message probes plus cooperative-driving off-policy evaluation.
unidentifiedVariables: Without randomized propensities and overlap, logged communication cannot identify unseen admission policies.
A message intervention changes future observations and traffic reactions, creating sequential interference.
Safety filtering before randomization changes the target population and must be part of the estimand.
dataLeakageRisks: Reconstructing propensities from outcomes instead of logging them at decision time.
Using the same route seeds for nuisance-model training and policy evaluation.
Training a world model on evaluation interventions and then calling its rollouts independent counterfactual evidence.
evaluationShortcuts: Randomizing only obviously irrelevant messages, which produces overlap but no informative treatment variation.
Reporting a low prediction error for an outcome model without direct randomized-policy validation.
Ignoring effective sample size, importance-weight tails, and disagreement among direct, inverse-propensity, and doubly robust estimates.
implementationRisks: Safety-preserving exploration restricts support and may require many scenarios.
Reactive closed-loop outcomes have high variance and long horizons.
The behavior policy, serialization, timing, and fallback action all need reproducible instrumentation.
mechanismAudits.redTeamDisposition: Retain after merging with the counterfactual harm gate and defining a conservative, safety-screened randomized logging policy.

strongestCollisions: All Vehicles Can Lie estimates malicious identities through pseudo-random grouping and Bayesian inference.
Pretend Benign preserves consensus while attacking selected regions and predicts future features for real-time execution.
MVIG learns defense-specific vulnerability information and breaks consensus-based defenses.
Earlier consensus defenses already reason over agreement among vehicles.
unidentifiedVariables: Different vehicles are not independent evidence when they share model weights, maps, calibration procedures, weather, or a common upstream RSU.
A lineage identifier is not evidence of independence unless it is cryptographically bound to an attested sensor, model, calibration, and network path.
Benign common-mode failures and coordinated attacks can be observationally equivalent.
dataLeakageRisks: Supplying privileged attacker labels or attack-generation metadata to the trust graph.
Defining lineage from simulator-only agent IDs unavailable in deployment.
Training and testing on the same attack implementation, target regions, and persistence schedules.
evaluationShortcuts: Counting vehicles instead of independent physical evidence roots.
Reporting attack detection rate without fixed false-positive rate, isolation delay, wrong-isolation cost, and clean utility.
Testing only single attackers or attacks that violate the defense's assumed consensus pattern.
implementationRisks: Most public datasets do not expose attested model, calibration, and network lineage.
Cryptographic identity does not establish statistical independence.
Over-conservative abstention can remove the cooperative benefit in dense or degraded scenes.
mechanismAudits.redTeamDisposition: Retain only after replacing vehicle-count trust with verifiable evidence-family roots and explicitly testing common-mode benign faults and colluding attacks.

strongestCollisions: Anytime-Valid Conformal Risk Control already provides time-uniform guarantees for a growing calibration stream.
Recent selective-acting work targets pathwise risk under adaptive control.
Uncertainty-aware fusion and selective rejection already cover the non-sequential application surface.
unidentifiedVariables: Exchangeability fails under adaptive message selection, route-dependent traffic, and online model updates.
Rare collision risk cannot be estimated from ordinary perception datasets without a defensible surrogate or targeted scenario distribution.
Per-frame miscoverage is not equivalent to route-level safety harm.
dataLeakageRisks: Reusing routes or scenario families across calibration and evaluation.
Tuning alarms after observing the evaluation stopping times.
Presenting a marginal conformal guarantee as selective or pathwise validity.
evaluationShortcuts: Average risk control instead of a time-uniform stopping-time guarantee.
Coverage reported without release rate, delay, escalation cost, and route completion.
A synthetic IID stream used to claim adaptive closed-loop validity.
implementationRisks: The safety event and filtration must be specified before deriving a valid e-process.
Conservative bounds may abstain or escalate too often to be useful.
A convincing empirical study needs substantially more closed-loop episodes than an AP benchmark.
mechanismAudits.redTeamDisposition: Defer as a standalone cooperative-perception Idea. It may later serve as a calibration wrapper after the causal logging and route-level harm definitions are validated.

strongestCollisions: RCP-Bench supplies controlled corruption benchmarks.
V2X-ReaLO and CooperScene supply real online or real C-V2X evidence.
MDrive supplies diverse reactive closed-loop scenarios.
A deployed hybrid Vehicle-in-the-Loop platform demonstrates a physical-virtual validation level.
unidentifiedVariables: Method rankings can change because the scenario, stack, metric, sensor suite, and model snapshot all change with evidence level.
Without paired scenarios or a transport model, a rank reversal cannot be attributed to evidence level.
Implementation quality can dominate the method effect.
dataLeakageRisks: Tuning each method separately on every evidence level.
Using the same digital-twin scenario for calibration and transfer evaluation.
Selecting only methods or metrics that remain stable after observing all levels.
evaluationShortcuts: Correlating headline numbers copied from unrelated papers.
Calling offline real logs a closed-loop real-world test.
Using rank correlation with too few methods and no uncertainty or inversion analysis.
implementationRisks: Paired ViL access may be unavailable, forcing the minimum study to stop at real-log replay.
Maintaining identical model snapshots, serialization, and metrics across stacks is engineering-heavy.
Some official datasets and frameworks lack verified licenses or executable releases.
mechanismAudits.redTeamDisposition: Retain as a benchmark-methodology candidate only if the study uses frozen implementations, paired scenario families, and uncertainty over rank inversions.

revisedReviewableCandidates.title: 安全随机消息探针驱动的反事实有害融合门
revisedReviewableCandidates.preciseClaim: For a predeclared safety-screened scenario population, estimate the conditional horizon-level effect of admitting one cooperative message versus dropping it, then reject only messages whose upper confidence bound on safety harm exceeds zero while falling back to ego-only.
identificationStrategy: Randomize admit/drop for a small, predeclared fraction of messages after a deterministic safety screen; log the exact propensity before observing outcomes.
Use paired seeds and a doubly robust sequential estimator with cross-fitted nuisance models.
Define treatment at message-region-time granularity and outcomes over a fixed planning horizon: collision, minimum TTC, route progress, comfort, violation, and serialized bytes.
Validate the offline estimate against held-out randomized rollouts before using it to train the gate.

dataAndSystems: OPV2V or V2XSet with controlled perturbations through OpenCOOD
MDrive or EI-Drive closed-loop scenarios with fixed map and traffic seeds
minimumExperiment.protocol: At least three independent route seeds per scenario family; split by map, route, actors, corruption process, and communication trace; report overlap, effective sample size, confidence intervals, and direct randomized-policy validation.
minimumExperiment.estimatedEffort: 8-12 weeks with one research engineer and one 24 GB CUDA GPU.

negativeControls: Sham randomization that changes a logged flag but not message delivery.
Messages from empty or planner-irrelevant remote regions.
Within-scene permutation of collaborator messages that preserves byte count and timing.
A placebo outcome measured before message delivery.
Equal-compute ego-only inference to exclude latency-induced gains.
failureCriteria: The treatment propensity has poor overlap or effective sample size is too small in safety-relevant strata.
Doubly robust estimates disagree materially with held-out randomized-policy outcomes.
The gate's upper-bound policy performs worse than ego-only on collision or minimum TTC.
Reported benefit disappears when actual serialization and end-to-end latency are included.
Performance fails to transfer to a second planner or a held-out corruption family.

revisedReviewableCandidates.title: 干预可识别的时钟—网络—位姿—标定联合误差后验
revisedReviewableCandidates.preciseClaim: A structured state-space posterior over clock offset and drift, network delay and AoI, ego-relative pose bias, extrinsic bias, and object motion can be identified under orthogonal interventions and improves calibrated online fusion under correlated drift without future frames.
identificationStrategy: Use hardware or simulator timestamps plus orthogonal designed interventions: clock drift ramps, queued network delay, rigid pose bias, extrinsic perturbation, and independently controlled object motion.
Anchor calibration with static structures and dynamic motion with tracked actors rather than asking one residual network to explain both.
Propagate posterior samples or a low-rank mixture through the warp and report both state recovery and downstream uncertainty.
Forbid future frames and simulator ground truth at inference; publish the filtration and available signals.

dataAndSystems: OPV2V or V2XSet for factorial interventions
V2V4Real or DAIR-V2X-Seq for held-out real sequences
CooperScene C-V2X traces if the required fields are released
minimumExperiment.protocol: Factorial train interventions, correlated held-out combinations, and one unseen drift process; split complete sequences and locations; evaluate state NLL, interval coverage, ECE, AP, tracking ID switches, and recovery frames.
minimumExperiment.estimatedEffort: 8-10 weeks after one official baseline environment is reproducible.

negativeControls: Shuffle temporal residuals while preserving marginal noise.
Fit an equally sized unstructured latent model.
Remove static anchors to test whether extrinsic bias becomes unidentifiable.
Give only one baseline the future frame to expose leakage sensitivity.
Evaluate on independent Gaussian noise as a deliberately easy control.
failureCriteria: Known intervention states are not recovered with calibrated intervals.
Joint and factorized posteriors are indistinguishable under correlated held-out drift.
Downstream gains vanish when future-frame access and oracle correspondences are removed.
Posterior sampling increases overconfidence, latency, or ID switches relative to a point estimate.
Results do not transfer from simulation to either V2V4Real, DAIR-V2X-Seq, or CooperScene.

revisedReviewableCandidates.title: 独立证据谱系下的 Byzantine 可观测性与安全弃权
revisedReviewableCandidates.preciseClaim: Trust should be conditioned on independent evidence roots rather than vehicle count. Fusion proceeds only when signed sensor, modality, model, calibration, view-geometry, and network-path lineages satisfy a predeclared observability condition; otherwise the system abstains to ego-only.
identificationStrategy: Define an evidence root as a verifiable tuple, not a learned vehicle embedding or raw identity.
Construct attack and benign-fault cells that vary one root at a time and include common-mode model, calibration, map, weather, and RSU failures.
State the Byzantine guarantee conditionally on attestation and root-independence assumptions; do not claim assumption-free defense.
Evaluate the abstention policy at fixed clean false-positive rate and fixed communication budget.

dataAndSystems: OPV2V or V2XSet for controlled collusion and duplicate-lineage tests
CooperScene for heterogeneous vehicle and RSU roots
RCP-Bench corruptions for benign common-mode failures
minimumExperiment.protocol: Cross attack family, persistence, attacker count, shared-root pattern, and benign common-mode fault; hold out one attack generator and one lineage pattern; report TPR at fixed FPR, isolation delay, wrong-isolation cost, clean AP, and fallback safety.
minimumExperiment.estimatedEffort: 8-12 weeks; cryptographic attestation may be emulated, but every emulated field must be labeled.

negativeControls: Duplicate one physical evidence stream under multiple vehicle identities.
Use distinct vehicles sharing the same model and calibration root.
Forge unsigned lineage metadata while preserving the sensor payload.
Apply severe benign weather or localization faults with no attacker.
Remove lineage fields at inference to verify safe abstention.
failureCriteria: The lineage score is effectively a monotone transform of agent count.
Common-mode attacks are not detected better than PRBI at the same clean false-positive rate.
Benign shared failures are systematically misclassified as attacks.
Missing or forged metadata leads to unsafe fusion instead of abstention.
The result disappears on a held-out attack or evidence-root pattern.

revisedReviewableCandidates.title: 配对证据阶梯上的方法排序迁移与反转概率
revisedReviewableCandidates.preciseClaim: With frozen method snapshots, paired scenario families, harmonized metrics, and explicit transport covariates, estimate the probability that cooperative-perception method rankings invert from controlled corruption to real-log replay and reactive closed loop.
identificationStrategy: Freeze code commit, checkpoint, sensor inputs, payload serialization, and metric definitions before opening higher evidence levels.
Build paired scenario families from common occlusion, merge, crossing, and braking mechanisms instead of comparing unrelated benchmark headlines.
Model method-by-level interactions and posterior rank-inversion probabilities with scenario-level uncertainty.
Treat ViL as an optional fourth level until a reproducible public facility is available; the minimum claim spans controlled corruption, real-log replay, and reactive closed loop.

dataAndSystems: MDrive or EI-Drive reactive closed loop
minimumExperiment.protocol: At least four frozen methods and 50 paired scenario families per available level; preregister transport covariates and metrics; report rank-inversion posterior, uncertainty, failure-set overlap, and sensitivity to implementation quality.
minimumExperiment.estimatedEffort: 10-12 weeks if existing checkpoints run; a fourth ViL level is out of scope until access and reproducibility are verified.

negativeControls: Shuffle scenario pairing across levels.
Allow per-level retuning as a deliberately biased comparator.
Duplicate a method checkpoint under a second name.
Replace actual bytes and latency with feature-mask size.
Use unrelated headline metrics to demonstrate the invalid naive procedure.
failureCriteria: Fewer than four methods or insufficient paired scenarios make inversion intervals uninformative.
Method snapshots, payloads, or metric definitions cannot be held fixed across levels.
Observed reversals are explained by implementation or tuning changes rather than level interactions.
Real-log replay is mislabeled as reactive closed loop.
No independent replication of at least one ranking cell is possible.

notAdvancedToReview.reason: The standalone estimand remains confounded and collides with planning-oriented communication; its useful part is absorbed into causal message admission.
A valid route-level filtration, harm event, and adaptive logging process are prerequisites; without them the guarantee is either marginal or vacuous.
A non-randomized gate cannot identify message harm; it is absorbed into the randomized causal-probe candidate.

redTeamConclusion: Four candidates are precise enough to enter independent review after the stated data and implementation prerequisites are confirmed. This audit does not score, accept, or claim that any candidate passes a gate.
